# PFF Grocer Storefront

> The premier online grocery destination for fresh produce, pantry essentials, and household items.

## Navigation

- [Home](/) - The homepage with featured category rails, popular brands, and current promotional campaigns.
- [Store](/store) - Browse all grocery and organic products. Supports filtering by brand, category, price range, and product specifications.
- [Brands](/brands) - View all trusted manufacturers and brands.
- [Blog](/blog) - Read the latest reviews, comparisons, and cooking articles.
